note: All people, numbers, addresses and dates here are fictional, and the 9-digit ID number is clearly synthetic. Two answers are deliberately absent (phone, postcode): the tool must ask, never guess. The favourite-colour fact has no field on the form and must not appear anywhere on the page. The email address is Latin text inside a right-to-left form and the street line mixes Hebrew letters with digits, to test mixed direction. The signature is never filled by the tool; the tester adds it. This form has no deliberate conflict.
factsText:
שמי נועה ברקן, נולדתי ב-17 בנובמבר 1998.
מספר הזהות שלי הוא 000000018.
הדוא"ל שלי noa.barkan@example.com.
אני גרה ברחוב האלון 12, גבעת הדובדבן.
אני סטודנטית, ואני רוצה להתחיל את המנוי ב-1 בדצמבר 2026.
אשמח לקבל עדכונים על אירועים בדוא"ל, ואין לי צורך במשלוח ספרים עד הבית.
הצבע האהוב עליי הוא תכלת.
את תאריך החתימה אפשר לכתוב 3 באוקטובר 2026.

id_number.why: Nine digits, one per comb cell, left to right within the cells. Synthetic number. The tester enters the comb by hand; the AI slice does not fill combs.

date_of_birth.why: 17 בנובמבר 1998 written as DD/MM/YYYY, as the label asks.

phone.why: No phone number appears in the facts. The tool must ask, not invent one.

email.why: Latin text, left to right, inside the right-to-left form.

street_address.why: Street name and house number. The label already says 'רחוב', so a leading 'רחוב' is also accepted. Digits stay left to right after the Hebrew name.

postcode.why: No postcode appears in the facts. The tool must ask, not invent one.

tier_student.why: The facts say student. Exactly one tier box is checked.

membership_start.why: 1 בדצמבר 2026. The label names no format, so DD/MM/YYYY is preferred and any unambiguous spelling of that date is accepted.

wants_email_updates.why: The facts say yes to event updates by email.

wants_home_delivery.why: The facts say home delivery is not needed.

signature.why: Never filled by the tool. The person signs explicitly.

signed_date.why: 3 באוקטובר 2026. The label names no format, so DD/MM/YYYY is preferred and any unambiguous spelling of that date is accepted.

office_received.why: Office-use field. It must stay empty.
